notes.title: Updates and Bugfixes (v0.3.73 patch notes)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have been working on the game silently all these while and we feel bad about it. So here's our first official note!


Recent Updates :

Added new scenarios

Added highlight outline when you are facing an interactable object

We added a Level Editor feature in the game (still Work In Progress) that allowing you to create puzzles and share it with everyone

Improved lighting

Added brightness setting

More interactables around the world!

Improved performance of the game

Improved localization


Bugfixes :

Fixed incorrect sprites' sorting order

Fixed a bug where loading a save file and triggering an event immediately will cause dialogue window getting stuck on the screen

Various bugfixes
